rationale: Retire Amber Infrastructure's unsupported active ownership period and mark Iowa RNG realized in the PortCo database. Green Impact Partners' February 2023 announcement described a conditional strategic agreement under which Amber would purchase 50% of Iowa RNG only after project documents, non-recourse debt financing, return thresholds, regulatory approval and other closing conditions were satisfied. GIP's first-quarter 2023 financial statements separately recorded the completed GreenGas Colorado sale but continued to describe Iowa RNG as conditional. GIP's second-quarter 2024 MD&A then stated that Amber's exclusive rights to provide Iowa RNG equity expired on June 30, 2024 and had not been extended. GIP's Q3 2025 MD&A and current project page continue to present Iowa RNG as a GIP development seeking financing, with no Amber ownership disclosure or subsequent closing found. The retired period records a proposed 50% interest that did not close and retains a null exit year; this is an administrative correction of erroneous active ownership, not a historical divestiture.

beforeImage.name: Iowa RNG
beforeImage.description: Iowa RNG is a renewable natural gas project associated with Green Impact Partners' North American RNG development program. The project is intended to supply low-carbon gas into transportation and energy markets and follows an asset-heavy contracted infrastructure model. Amber's 2023 partnership with Green Impact included the purchase of a 50% equity interest in Iowa RNG. Public materials provide less operating detail for this project than for GreenGas Colorado or Future Energy Park, but they clearly identify Iowa RNG as part of the partnership package. Reviewed public sources do not disclose the project's detailed commercial structure beyond the disclosed 50-50 sponsor ownership.

afterImage.name: Iowa RNG
afterImage.description: Iowa RNG is a three-dairy renewable natural gas development in northwest Iowa led by Green Impact Partners. In February 2023 GIP announced a conditional strategic agreement under which Amber Infrastructure was expected to invest in 50% of the project. GIP's first-quarter 2023 financial statements continued to describe that interest as conditional and separately recorded only the GreenGas Colorado closing. GIP's second-quarter 2024 MD&A stated that Amber's exclusive Iowa RNG equity-funding rights expired on June 30, 2024 and had not been extended. GIP's Q3 2025 reporting and current project page continue to present Iowa RNG as a GIP development seeking financing. No official evidence was found that Amber's proposed Iowa RNG investment closed, so Amber is not represented as a current owner.

milestones.event: Amber's exclusive rights to provide Iowa RNG equity financing expired and had not been extended as of Green Impact Partners' August 2024 filing.
